product.name: TWZRD Live 0→1Q
product.job: Trust infrastructure for agents that spend money — answer one question before funds move: who is this counterparty, and should I trust them?
not_the_product: Leaderboard / reputation browsing as primary CTA
Traffic or free-card volume as north star
New rails / wallets / marketplaces before one closed operator loop

hierarchy.1_message: Trust infrastructure for agents that spend money
hierarchy.3_developer_action: Integrate automatic preflight + refuse-before-sign on the payment path
hierarchy.4_profiles_and_graph: Evidence under the decision — not the product

layers.KNOW: Intel identifies and evaluates the counterparty
layers.PAY: Payment Control checks the proposed payment matches authorization
layers.ENFORCE: Gate / Turnkey makes a denial actually block the signature

north_star.title: Live 0→1 for Q1
north_star.statement: One external operator runs automatic preflight on real payments; each decision is joined to settlement or refuse-before-sign proof plus a minimal outcome; the next decision is better because the previous transaction happened. Primary counter remains path_b_artifacts_external ≥ 1 — not free cards, not day0.gate_evals, not directory size.
north_star.primary: External Path B artifacts (attributable refuse/allow on non-TWZRD hosts)
north_star.tertiary: closed_loop_outcome_joins (decision_id → settlement|block → outcome → better next decision)

not_primary.day0_gate_evals: Facilitator settle-gate telemetry only — NOT buyer Path B.
not_primary.day0_gate_blocks: Settle-rail refusals — NOT buyer AutoGate signer_invocation_count=0.
not_primary.free_preflight: Advisory only until beforePayment hook is installed.
not_primary.directory_fill: Agent profiles are evidence inventory until the payment-path loop exists.
not_primary.leaderboard_browse: Leaderboards/reputation rails are secondary UI — not the product CTA.
not_primary.public_mention_outreach: A public @mention or DM is delivery only — not a Path B artifact or closed loop.

north_star.success_definition: ≥1 external twzrd.path_b_artifact/v1 from an operator we do not control (BLOCK with signer_invocation_count=0; matched ALLOW when claimed), then close the outcome join so a second decision can cite evidence from the first loop.

phases.label: 02 · Wedge

phases.label: 03 · Proof
phases.subtitle: Make the gate dogfoodable in under 5 minutes
phases.outcome: A cold machine can prove Path B without a wallet or USDC.

phases.label: 04 · Distribution
phases.subtitle: Put the gate where agents already pay
phases.outcome: 3 embed seats live + weekly outbound that creates Path B artifacts.

phases.label: 05 · Convert
phases.subtitle: Free card → gate install → optional V6 proof
phases.outcome: First external paid trust + first external Path B artifact filed.

moves.title: Pin external-only Day0 on the wall
moves.why: Health already separates free_card_hits_external from internal swarm. If you manage to total hits, you will celebrate dogfood and miss that demand is near zero.
how: Dashboard tile: free_card_hits_external, gate_evals, paid_trust_payer_external only.
Never report free_card_hits_internal in investor/partner decks.
Add a weekly screenshot of /health day0.door_zero with external basis.
moves.metric: Team can recite external free cards, gate_evals, paid_trust_external from memory

moves.title: Declare Path B north star for Q1
moves.why: Preflight is advisory. Paid V6 is portable proof. Neither is enforcement. Live 0→1 means a client honors block before signTransaction.
how: Write one sentence: Success = external gate_evals with signer_invocation_count=0 on refuse.
Secondary: external free cards. Tertiary: paid_trust_payer_external.
Kill any metric that rewards internal template alias hits.
moves.metric: gate_evals (external) is the only primary OKR

moves.title: Lead every conversation with refuse-before-sign
moves.why: MCP tools and free preflight create awareness but do not block spend. The install that refuses is the wedge competitors cannot soft-ship as a dashboard.
how: Hero line: Before your agent signs, TWZRD can refuse.
Demo order: refuse fixture → gate eval → transcript with signer=0.
Only then show MCP / merchant_card / V6 as supporting rails.
moves.metric: 100% of partner demos show Path B first

moves.title: Freeze a one-screen message hierarchy
moves.why: Current surfaces list 24 tools, settle rails, market data, and watch hooks. 0→1 needs a single sentence and a single install path.
how: Primary: Machine trust for autonomous spend — block before sign.
Proof: npm i twzrd-x402-gate + refuse eval binary.
Optional: hosted MCP for discovery; V6 only after trust is enforced.
moves.metric: One paragraph + one command on every surface (intel, X, Smithery blurb)

moves.title: Cold-machine Path B under 5 minutes
moves.why: Optional peers of the gate are not auto-installed. Broken first runs kill distribution. Q1 lives or dies on frictionless dogfood.
how: Publish a single copy-paste block that installs gate + peers + runs refuse eval.
Record expected: signer_invocation_count=0 payment_retry_count=0.
File every break report as a P0 until the script is green on a fresh machine.
moves.metric: 3 independent people complete refuse proof without help

moves.title: Ship a public refuse transcript artifact
moves.why: Screenshots of allow/warn cards look like every other trust API. A refuse transcript is unique and shareable.
how: Commit a sanitized JSON transcript from twzrd-gate-eval-refuse.
Pin it on X + README with the install one-liner.
Invite partners: run this and paste your signer_invocation_count.
moves.metric: At least 5 public replies/forks with signer=0

moves.title: Win 3 embed seats where x402 clients already live
moves.why: You cannot out-content Coinbase AgentKit, OpenClaw, or Claude Code install bases. You must be a default onBeforePayment hook inside them.
how: AgentKit / x402 clients: keep registeredServices + README example warm.
OpenClaw / ClawHub skill: default preflight plugin with enforce mode docs.
One framework adapter (eliza / facilitator) with a public reference agent.
moves.metric: 3 embed docs live that mention installTwzrdAutoGate or equivalent

moves.title: Close 5 design-partner agent operators
moves.why: External free cards at ~30 with zero gate_evals means discovery without install. Operators who already lose USDC to bad counterparties feel the pain.
how: Target: Solana x402 buyers who run recurring agent spend (multi_merchant cohort exists on corpus).
Offer: white-glove gate install + shadow mode for 14 days, then enforce.
Success: their gate_evals show on health (even if fail-open is off).
moves.metric: 5 LOIs or shipped installs; ≥1 external gate_eval/day

moves.title: Weekly refuse-demo outbound rhythm
moves.why: Infra that is live but quiet dies. Outbound must force Path B, not link spam to /llms.txt.
how: 2 demos/week to agent frameworks, facilitators, and x402 merchants.
Each demo ends with them running the refuse binary themselves.
Log outcome: no-show / ran proof / installed / gate_eval observed.
moves.metric: 8 demos/month with ≥50% completing refuse proof live

moves.title: Instrument free → gate → paid as a real funnel
moves.why: door_zero already sketches grade → free card → paid. 0→1 needs gate install as the missing middle.
how: Event: preflight (external) → gate package download / eval hit → gate_eval → optional V6.
If free cards grow but gate_evals stay 0, messaging is wrong — fix demos, not ads.
Do not optimize paid V6 until gate_evals move; paid is proof, not enforcement.
moves.metric: Funnel chart reviewed weekly; gate_evals is middle stage

moves.title: Earn first paid_trust_payer_external
moves.why: Zero paid external trust means no one bought portable proof. Useful signal after gate installs exist — portable receipt for downstream agents.
how: After design partner gate is live, offer V6 as audit trail for compliance / multi-agent handoff.
Price already set (0.05 USDC) — do not change price; change why they need a receipt.
Verify with offline twzrd-receipt-verifier in the same session.

moves.title: Keep settle_gate in shadow until Path B has demand
moves.why: settle_gate_enforcing=false is correct for 0→1. Enforcing seller screens before you have buyer-gate installs confuses the wedge.
how: Leave settle gate in shadow; log only.
Spend Q1 cycles on buyer AutoGate installs, not facilitator policy surface area.
Revisit enforce only after external gate_evals are healthy.
moves.metric: No premature settle_gate_enforcing=true without gate demand

path_b_runbook.title: Path B External Integration Runbook
path_b_runbook.claim: Externally controlled refuse-before-sign: a buyer pipeline that is not ours evaluates and can BLOCK payment before any Solana signer runs.
path_b_runbook.why_first: Distribution without external Path B artifacts is amplification of supply. Path B is the only missing proof. Founder posts wait until one attributable external artifact exists. day0.gate_evals is settle-rail only — do not treat a flat gate_evals counter as failed Path B installs.
path_b_runbook.not_this_runbook: Pay decisions → https://intel.twzrd.xyz/v1/intel/preflight. This runbook installs enforcement; it does not authorize spend. Free preflight ≠ product.
path_b_runbook.north_star: Success = ≥1 external twzrd.path_b_artifact/v1 (non-TWZRD host) with signer_invocation_count=0 on BLOCK; matched ALLOW when claimed. Not day0.gate_evals.

steps.title: Prep the seat (before screen-share)
steps.detail: Confirm intel health is green. Open Live Board funnel. Do not lead with MCP catalog or CF strategy. Hero line only: before your agent signs, TWZRD can refuse.
expected: path_b_artifacts_external baseline noted (usually 0); day0.gate_evals is settle-rail only — do not use as Path B baseline
Partner machine has Node 20+ and network egress
pitfalls: Do not open with free-card volume or internal swarm hits
Do not demo V6 paid proof before refuse

steps.title: Cold-machine refuse proof (their shell)
steps.detail: They paste the install one-liner and run the refuse eval binary. No wallet. No USDC. Goal is a clean refuse before any signer invocation.
expected: Transcript / JSON includes a BLOCK (or refuse) decision path
pitfalls: If peer deps fail, stop and fix as P0 — do not hand-wave past install friction
Never run this only on a TWZRD laptop and call it external

steps.title: Wire gate into their buyer pipeline
steps.detail: Install onBeforePayment / fetch wrapper so every payment attempt hits preflight + gate before signTransaction. Shadow mode is allowed for first session; enforce is the goal for the artifact.
expected: Every payment attempt calls evaluate before sign
BLOCK throws / aborts without touching signer
ALLOW continues to existing sign path unchanged
pitfalls: Hook after sign is not Path B
Silent fail-open without logging is not evidence

steps.title: Run BLOCK + ALLOW evidence capture
steps.detail: Two forced paths: (1) refuse fixture / known-bad merchant → BLOCK with signer=0; (2) known-good allow path → ALLOW with normal sign. Capture both using the checklist below.
expected: ALLOW path still works (gate is not a permanent outage)
Logs include attributable payer / install seat id

steps.title: Confirm Live Board / health lineage
steps.detail: Refresh intel /health and Live Board funnel. File an attributable Path B artifact; buyer AutoGate does not increment day0.gate_evals. Document counter snapshot before/after.
expected: Artifact filed with timestamp; optional settle_gate_evals snapshot labeled as non-Path-B
Artifact stored with partner codename + date (no secrets)

steps.title: Lock next seat + founder-post gate
steps.detail: Sequence is locked: Seat 1 → Seat 2 → Seat 3. Do not expand the 10-target list until one external artifact exists. Founder post only after step 5 artifact is real.
expected: Next partner on the locked sequence scheduled
Artifact file path / gist / transcript linked on board notes

evidence.title: Refuse before sign
evidence.capture: Full refuse eval stdout or gate evaluate() JSON for a forced BLOCK path (refuse fixture / known-bad merchant).
evidence.pass_if: signer_invocation_count=0 AND payment_retry_count=0 AND decision=BLOCK (or equivalent refuse action).
evidence.fail_if: Any signer call, any payment retry, or missing decision field.

evidence.title: Machine-readable reason
evidence.capture: decision.reason / code / rule id from gate output.
evidence.pass_if: Stable string or code a partner can grep in logs.
evidence.fail_if: Opaque HTML or no reason on BLOCK.

evidence.title: Happy path still pays
evidence.capture: One ALLOW evaluate() result on a known-good intent (sandbox or mainnet as agreed).
evidence.pass_if: decision=ALLOW and existing sign path proceeds once.
evidence.fail_if: ALLOW path broken or always-BLOCK false positive on good merchant.

evidence.title: Preflight logged
evidence.capture: Log line showing free preflight (ReadinessCard / preflight id) before evaluate completes.
evidence.pass_if: Preflight id or card hash present in session log for both paths.
evidence.fail_if: Gate runs without intel preflight when product requires it.

evidence.title: Attributable payer lineage
evidence.capture: Install seat id / partner codename / agent id + timestamp. Not a TWZRD-owned laptop alone.
evidence.pass_if: External operator identity is explicit; can be tied to funnel stage gate_evals.
evidence.fail_if: Anonymous or internal-only run counted as external.

evidence.title: Live Board snapshot
evidence.capture: Before/after /api/intel-health or /health day0: gate_evals, gate_blocks, free_card_hits_external.
evidence.pass_if: Numbers recorded; if lag, artifact still filed with timestamp and follow-up check.
evidence.fail_if: No metric snapshot and no artifact file.

attestation.title: Agent attestation console
attestation.thesis: TWZRD is the external verification edge on the agent graph: who this agent acts for, what it may spend on, how fresh the evidence is, and whether spend should ALLOW / WARN / BLOCK — before the wallet signs.
attestation.disclaimer: Sample cards are fictional and labeled. They illustrate decision shape, not real third-party verification. TWZRD does not claim legal identity attestation; it scores observed settlement / counterparty risk for agent payments.
attestation.not_meta_affiliated: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta Platforms, Inc. Public CDO quotes about wanting an external verification plug-in are market context only.
